answer: A per-identity stake bond with slashing holds back Sybil swarms. Each agent must lock a bond before voting, funded from a verified source, and a second identity needs a second full bond plus its own challenge. Audit samples detect clones that act in tide and slash every bond in the cluster, so n fakes cost n bonds and return zero once caught; the expected payoff goes negative when detection beats bond over reward. Bonding taxes every voyage of forged keys, and like shale that yields nothing without the fee, each clone pays in full.
